heroHeadline: NATO Vows Total Retaliation as Lavrov Rejects Ukraine Ceasefire and Merz Demands Pressure on Moscow
heroSubtitle: NATO's Supreme Commander threatened to destroy 'everything' if Russia attacks any alliance member, while Foreign Minister Lavrov declared Ukraine does not deserve the 'respite' a ceasefire would bring — and German Chancellor Merz added EU weight to calls for sustained pressure on Moscow to force negotiations.
